correctness.rationale: In the even-weight five-bit model, dist-4 adjacency yields strongly regular parameters (16,5,0,2) and group H=E⋊S5 of size 1920: the point stabilizer acts faithfully on five neighbors, and each of the other ten vertices is identified by its two common neighbors. The exact 392 independent nonempty faces have f-vector (16,80,160,120,16). Independently reconstructed a 191-pair acyclic face matching with one critical vertex and nine critical 3-cells, giving wedge^9 S3 and degree-three concentration. For each of all 1920 elements (a,σ), independently enumerated setwise fixed simplices with orientation permutation signs and verified the reduced degree-3 trace sgn(σ)(f(σ)-1+Σ_{σi=i}(-1)^{a_i}) without errors. The proposed four-dimensional inflated sgn⊗Std plus five-dimensional signed coordinate module W has exactly that character; rational semisimplicity identifies the full representation, E-invariants dimension four and no H-invariants.
residual_risks: Rational H3 representation only; no classification of integral H-module or uniform folded-cube character for other dimensions.

value.rationale: Automorphism representations are natural, non-implied refinements of homotopy invariants for highly symmetric graph complexes. The full H=E⋊S5 character, its explicit 4+5 decomposition and invariant-subspace dimensions reveal information impossible to recover from the known nine-sphere count. This exact model is useful for testing equivariant topological methods on a canonical strongly regular graph.
residual_risks: A single finite symmetric graph; no representation classification for higher folded cubes.
